boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Ohio Northern spaces for studying, gathering, performances, reflection, and campus events, each supported by a direct university source.

cards.title: Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Set up a group work session in the open, media-rich first-floor learning area, then use the library’s room tools if your group needs a reservable space.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study setting inside Heterick Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes the Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center as an open, comfortable, well-lit, media-rich collaborative-learning space on Heterick Library’s first floor.
cards.access_notes: Use during library access hours; consult the library for room availability and reservations.

cards.title: Heterick Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Choose a study spot, ask a librarian for research help, or plan an archives visit in advance when you need university-history materials.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s library for research support, study, and archival materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Heterick Memorial Library offers library resources and research help, and its archives reading room is on the third floor; archives access is by appointment.
cards.access_notes: Archives access requires an appointment; confirm library hours before visiting.

cards.title: The Tundra
cards.subtitle: Between residence halls and academic buildings
cards.notes: Use the broad lawn as a daylight meet-up point or check the campus calendar for events scheduled on this central green.
cards.short_summary: An 8.56-acre campus lawn used for events and student downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies the Tundra as the grassy area between residence halls and academic buildings and says it serves as a location for events and student downtime.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use consideration for scheduled events and weather conditions.

cards.title: English Chapel
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Attend Thursday Spiritual Hour, visit for a scheduled student gathering, or contact Religious and Spiritual Life about programs and space access.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel hosting Spiritual Hour and religious-life programming.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists Thursday 11 a.m. Spiritual Hour in English Chapel/Burgett and describes the chapel as a longstanding center of campus spirituality.
cards.source_title: Religious and Spiritual Life | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Program times and building access vary; contact the Office of Religious and Spiritual Life for arrangements.

cards.title: Bear Cave
cards.subtitle: McIntosh Center
cards.notes: Look for a campus event using the Bear Cave, or ask McIntosh Center staff whether the space is available for a student program.
cards.short_summary: A named McIntosh Center venue used for university programming.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s 2026 Oratory & Art Festival lists the Bear Cave and McIntosh Center as its location.
cards.source_title: Camps & Summer Classes | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Event and room availability vary; confirm access with McIntosh Center staff.

cards.title: Sculpture Mall
cards.subtitle: East of McIntosh Center, between Presser and Weber halls
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor campus stretch as a meeting point before a nearby event, keeping clear of activities that have reserved the lawn.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor mall east of McIntosh Center between Presser and Weber halls.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU places its Oratory & Art Festival on the sculpture mall east of McIntosh Center between Presser and Weber halls.
cards.source_title: Camps & Summer Classes | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor area; availability can be affected by scheduled campus events.

cards.entity_name: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Check the season calendar for a student production, concert, or visiting act, and use the box office for current ticket and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s performing-arts venue for student productions and visiting acts.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says student productions fill the Freed Center during the season and identifies it as a campus performing-arts venue.
cards.access_notes: Performance admission and availability vary by event; the box office is open Monday through Friday, noon to 4:30 p.m.

cards.title: Biggs Theatre
cards.subtitle: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Reserve or pick up tickets for an announced performance, then arrive before curtain time and follow the venue’s late-seating guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies Biggs Theatre as a 551-seat theatre within the Freed Center and notes wheelchair-accessible seating on two levels.
cards.access_notes: Ticket requirements vary by event; wheelchair-accessible seating and assisted listening devices are available.

cards.title: Stambaugh Studio Theatre
cards.subtitle: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Watch the Freed Center schedule for a studio-theatre event, and check with the box office about ticketing and seating before you go.
cards.short_summary: A flexible studio theatre at the Freed Center.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies Stambaugh Studio Theatre as a Freed Center venue with 34 seats per section and a 136-seat maximum capacity.
cards.access_notes: Ticket requirements and event availability vary; contact the Freed Center box office for current details.

cards.title: ONU Sports Center Field House
cards.subtitle: 609 Lincoln Avenue, Ada
cards.notes: Check the athletics or university events calendar before visiting; the field house hosts major assemblies and other scheduled campus functions.
cards.short_summary: A field house used for athletics, recreation, assemblies, and commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that the Sports Center accommodates intercollegiate athletics, physical education, recreation activities, commencements, special events, and assembly programs.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on athletics, recreation, and event scheduling; follow posted event instructions.
